ai_summary: Abans Enterprises Limited's material subsidiary, Abans Gems and Jewels Trading FZC, has reported the immediate resignation of its statutory auditors, M/s. Abdulaziz Panis and Shah Associates, effective August 13, 2026. While the auditors cited "pre-occupation" as the sole reason with no other concerns, any mid-term auditor change for a material subsidiary warrants scrutiny. M/s. Al Jeroudy Accounting & Auditing L.L.C. was simultaneously appointed to fill the casual vacancy, mitigating immediate operational impact on the subsidiary's financial reporting for the year ending March 31, 2027.
